title: docs(adr-0055,skills-data): wording follow-ups from the writeRequiresMasterRead reviews
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9B6XCSGFtBWMTfzkHVAwJSu)_

Fixes #33432

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：ADR-0055 补 5 处措辞（7 Sep 链式写入条与 7 Nov 状态行加 ⚠️ 指向 11-14 修订、"every refusal" 收窄为 "every master-gate refusal"、裁决原文补上末句「HotCRM 的设计授权全部兑现。」、补一句"读不到主记录的人按条件批量写入时什么都不写"）；data 技能 relationships.md 两处措辞、对应 eval 加 3 条 must_not_contain。
- 为什么改：两次契约复审留下的措辞尾巴。旧措辞会让读者以为开了 writeRequiresMasterRead 后设置主记录仍要编辑权，从而给主记录多授编辑权。
- 风险与回滚：纯文字，无代码、无契约改动；技能文件 token 数不变（4232/4232），棘轮行未动。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：docs/adr/0055-master-detail-controlled-by-parent.md（第 10、141、273、286、298 行），skills/objectstack-data/rules/relationships.md（第 85–91、110–111 行）。
- 两分钟验证：`node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs && pnpm check:adr-symbol-anchors && pnpm check:adr-index`，预期全部 exit 0，relationships.md 显示 4232 / 4232。
- 需要你做的：批准本 PR（受管面 Tier H，docs/adr/** 与 skills/**）。

## What changes

**`docs/adr/0055-master-detail-controlled-by-parent.md`** (review 6883816828, nits 1 to 5; every nit re-read on main `e71ecc1b`, none already settled, so none dropped). The 2026-11-15 notes from PR #33992 (#33696) are untouched.

1. The 2026-09-07 amendment's **Write** bullet ("running the same three master-edit legs … on every hop") keeps its sentence and gains an in-place `⚠️ Amended 2026-11-14 (#33250 / PR #33369)` note: a hop that declares `writeRequiresMasterRead` asks read and ends the walk (`security-plugin-cbp-write-gate.ts#assertControlledByParentChainEditable`), pointing to the 2026-11-14 amendment.
2. The 2026-11-07 status line ("setting a master asks edit on it, emptying one asks edit on the stored master") gains a ⚠️ note in the form the 2026-10-26 line already carries: on an opted-in detail the new and the stored master are each asked read; the null-master owner rule is unchanged. `scripts/adr-index.mjs --json` output is byte-identical before and after (`cmp` exit 0): its status reader reads only the `**Status**:` line.
3. "### The invariant": "every refusal still says 'requires edit access'" → "every master-gate refusal …" (the 2026-11-07 null-master owner refusal never said that; the code agrees: `masterGateRefusalUserCopyOf` answers `undefined` for it).
4. The ruling quote is called verbatim and now is: the record 6880588685's last sentence 「HotCRM 的设计授权全部兑现。」 is added, byte-identical to the record's option text (141 bytes each), and the English gloss covers it.
5. "What a refusal answers" gains the predicate case: a predicate (`multi: true`) update or delete by a caller who cannot read the master selects none of that master's rows, judges no master for them and writes none of them, with no refusal, as on a detail that does not opt in. Verified by reading main: `security-plugin-addressed-writes.ts#readableRowsScopeForPredicateWrite` narrows the matched set to readable rows, and `security-plugin-cbp-write-gate.ts#controlledByParentPredicateWriteMasters` judges the masters of those rows only; the opt-in never touches the read side (zero `writeRequiresMasterRead` hits in the read filter, addressed-writes and authz middleware). Worded per master, because one predicate can also select rows under masters the caller does read.

**`skills/objectstack-data/rules/relationships.md`** (review 6883930925):

- N1: "(even under `ownerMayEdit`; read under `writeRequiresMasterRead`)" → "(both even under `ownerMayEdit`; read for both under `writeRequiresMasterRead`)": setting and emptying a master both ask read under the key.
- N2: the ownership floor now binds on-behalf-of updates and deletes "for both users" (ADR-0055 2026-11-14: a delegated by-id write keeps both principals' floors, ADR-0090 D10).
- Paid by one cut in the same section (standing ruling 「A:先削重复,余额按实测提高」): the `ownerMayEdit` bullet's list "insert, delete, predicate (`multi: true`) updates and on-behalf-of writes still need master edit" → "every other write, on-behalf-of included, still needs master edit". Surviving homes: the section's own default two lines above ("by default, every write needs edit on the master") with the bullet's "only"; the `multi: true` gloss lives in `references/data-hooks.md` and `rules/security.md`. No re-wrap pays for anything.

**`skills/objectstack-data/evals/objects-fields-relationships.json`**: the `writeRequiresMasterRead` case (found by content, `id: 17`) gains three `must_not_contain` strings: both orders of `ownerMayEdit: true` beside the key, and the key on the `master_detail` field (`required: true, writeRequiresMasterRead`). None occurs in the case's own `expected_output`; all four `must_contain` strings do. No other case changes (JSON compare against the base).

**`.changeset/33432-cbp-write-opt-in-wording.md`**: `@objectstack/skills` patch, carrying both declaration lines.

### Token readings (`ceil(utf8 bytes / 4)`, `node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`)

| Reading | Before | After |
|---|---|---|
| `rules/relationships.md` (ceiling 4232) | 4232 (16925 bytes) | 4232 (16925 bytes), headroom 0, row unchanged |
| `evals/objects-fields-relationships.json` (not ratcheted) | 5466 | 5511 |
| Whole `skills/objectstack-data` package | 52950 | 52995 |
| Sum of all `SKILL.md` | 59218 | 59218 |
| Bundle total (whole shipped tree) | 246388 | 246433 |

The +45 is the eval file alone.

## Why

Authors and agents read ADR-0055 and the data skill to decide which grant a detail write asks. A stale bullet or an open-scoped parenthetical tells some readers that setting a master still asks edit under the opt-in, and they over-grant edit on the master to get a write through.

## Acceptance notes

- **Authoring tier (deviation, declared).** `dispatch-gates --tier` makes the contract-review tier MANDATORY for `docs/adr/**` and `skills/**`; the card thread is served below it, so the text was authored and committed by an isolated os-dev subagent pinned to that tier on this branch. The thread merged main, ran the gates, opened this PR and wrote the report.
- Observation, nothing filed: the 2026-11-07 "Chains" bullet ("a chain hop with no master of its own ends the chain under the same rule") carries no 2026-11-14 note; the 2026-11-14 Gate bullet covers it in general terms. Not one of the five nits.
- Carrier #33696: once its code lands, one reader class reads a required master's empty or dangling rows; the 404 sentence and the new predicate sentence both rest on "a detail row's read derives from its master (§2)" and will need that card's note.
- Eval limits: the three strings catch single-line spellings only. The case's `expected_output` still says the floor "binds predicate and on-behalf-of updates and deletes" (true, not refined to "both users"); left, since only `must_not_contain` was in scope.
- Forced test edits: none.

## Verification

Head `e84ff32f` (base `fb79d47c` + merge of main `e71ecc1b`). `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derived 51 commands; each run with its exit captured before any pipe, then reconciled with `--ran`.

Also exit 0 on the authored head `c5cc5319`: `pnpm check:skill-eval-tokens` (ui), `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:skill-docs`, `check:skill-refs`, `check:skill-examples`, `node scripts/adr-index.mjs --check`, `check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs --self-test` (104 cases).

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (not touched)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind. (no names added)

- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed. (not touched)

- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
